pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena Āḷavakā bhikkhū saṃyācikāyo kuṭiyo kārāpenti assāmikāyo attuddesikāyo appamāṇikāyo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.5: purisaṃ detha purisatthakaraṃ detha goṇaṃ detha sakaṭaṃ detha vāsiṃ detha pharasuṃ detha kuṭhāriṃ detha kuddālaṃ detha nikhādanaṃ detha valliṃ detha veḷuṃ detha muñjaṃ detha babbajaṃ detha tiṇaṃ detha mattikaṃ dethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.6: manussā upaddutā yācanāya upaddutā viññattiyā bhikkhū disvā ubbijjanti pi uttasanti pi palāyanti pi aññena pi gacchanti aññena pi mukhaṃ karonti dvāraṃ pi thakenti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.7: gāvī pi disvā palāyanti bhikkhū 'ti maññamānā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.8: atha kho āyasmā Mahākassapo Rājagahe vassaṃ vuttho yena Āḷavī tena pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.10: tatra sudaṃ āyasmā Mahākassapo Āḷaviyaṃ viharati Aggāḷave cetiye.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.11: atha kho āyasmā Mahākassapo pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Āḷaviṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.12: manussā āyasmantaṃ Mahākassapaṃ passitvā ubbijjanti pi uttasanti pi palāyanti pi aññena pi gacchanti aññena pi mukhaṃ karonti dvāraṃ pi thakenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.13: atha kho āyasmā Mahākassapo Āḷaviyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.14: pubbāyaṃ āvuso Āḷavī subhikkhā ahosi sulabhapiṇḍā sukarā uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.15: etarahi panāyaṃ Āḷavī dubbhikkhā dullabhapiṇḍā na sukarā uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.16: ko nu kho āvuso hetu ko paccayo yenāyaṃ Āḷavī dubbhikkhā dullabhapiṇḍā na sukarā uñchena paggahena yāpetun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.1.17: atha kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahākassapassa etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.2.1: atha kho bhagavā Rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Āḷavī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.2.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Āḷavī tad avasari.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.2.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Āḷaviyaṃ viharati Aggāḷave cetiye.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.2.4: atha kho āyasmā Mahākassapo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.2.5: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Mahākassapo bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.2.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā Āḷavake bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.2.7: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave saṃyācikāyo kuṭiyo kārāpetha assāmikāyo attuddesikāyo appamāṇikāyo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.2.14: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā saṃyācikāyo kuṭiyo kārāpessatha . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.2.18: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.2.19: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi: ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave dve bhātaro isayo Gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ upanissāya vihariṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.2: atha kho bhikkhave Maṇikaṇṭho nāgarājā Gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ uttaritvā yena kaniṭṭho isi ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā kaniṭṭhaṃ isiṃ sattakkhattuṃ bhogehi parikkhipitvā upari muddhani mahantaṃ phaṇaṃ karitvā aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.3: atha kho bhikkhave kaniṭṭho isi tassa nāgassa bhayā kiso ahosi lūkho dubbaṇṇo uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajāto dhammanisanthatagatto.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.4: addasa kho bhikkhave jeṭṭho isi kaniṭṭhaṃ isiṃ kisaṃ lūkhaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātaṃ dhamanisanthatagattaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.6: kissa tvaṃ bho kiso lūkho . . . dhamanisanthatagatto 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.7: idha me bho Maṇikaṇṭho nāgarājā Gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ uttaritvā yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ sattakkhattuṃ bhogehi parikkhipitvā upari muddhani mahantaṃ phaṇaṃ karitvā aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.8: tassāhaṃ bho nāgassa bhayā kiso lūkho . . . dhamanisanthatagatto 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.9: icchasi pana tvaṃ bho tassa nāgassa anāgamanan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.10: icchām' ahaṃ bho tassa nāgassa anāgamanan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.11: api pana tvaṃ bho tassa nāgassa kiñci passasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.12: passām' ahaṃ bho maṇissa kaṇṭhe pilandhanan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.13: tena hi tvaṃ bho taṃ nāgaṃ maṇiṃ yāca,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.16: atha kho bhikkhave Maṇikaṇṭho nāgarājā Gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ uttaritvā yena kaniṭṭho isi ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.17: ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho bhikkhave Maṇikaṇṭhaṃ nāgarājānaṃ kaniṭṭho isi etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.21: bhikkhu maṇiṃ yācati, bhikkhussa maṇinā attho 'ti khippañ ñeva agamāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.22: dutiyam pi kho bhikkhave Maṇikaṇṭho nāgarājā Gaṅgaṃ . . . upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.23: addasa kho bhikkhave kaṇiṭṭho isi Maṇikaṇṭhaṃ nāgarājānaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.28: bhikkhu maṇiṃ yācati, bhikkhussa maṇinā attho 'ti tato 'va paṭinivatti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.29: tatiyam pi kho bhikkhave Maṇikaṇṭho nāgarājā Gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ uttarati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.30: addasa kho bhikkhave kaniṭṭho isi Maṇikaṇṭhaṃ nāgarājānaṃ Gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ uttarantaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.34: atha kho bhikkhave Maṇikaṇṭho nāgarājā kaniṭṭhaṃ isiṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.42: na cāpi te assamaṃ āgamissan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.44: bhikkhu maṇiṃ yācati, bhikkhussa maṇinā attho 'ti pakkāmi
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.45: tadā pakkanto 'va ahosi, na puna paccāgañchi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.46: atha kho bhikkhave kaniṭṭho isi tassa nāgassa dassanīyassa adassanena bhiyyosomattāya kiso ahosi lūkho dubbaṇṇo uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajāto dhamanisanthatagatto.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.47: addasa kho bhikkhave jeṭṭho isi kaniṭṭhaṃ isiṃ bhiyyosomattāya kisaṃ lūkhaṃ . . . dhamanisanthatagattaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.49: kissa tvaṃ bho bhiyyosomattāya kiso lūkho . . . dhamanisanthatagatto 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.50: tassāhaṃ bho nāgassa dassanīyassa adassanena bhiyyosomattāya kiso lūkho . . . dhamanisanthatagatto 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.51: atha kho bhikkhave jeṭṭho isi kaniṭṭhaṃ isiṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.52: na taṃ yāce yassa piyaṃ jigiṃse,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.3.56: hi nāma bhikkhave tiracchānagatānaṃ pāṇānaṃ amanāpā bhavissati yācanā amanāpā viññatti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.4.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave aññataro bhikkhu Himavantapasse viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.4.2: tassa kho bhikkhave vanasaṇḍassa avidūre mahantaṃ ninnaṃ pallalaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.4.3: atha kho bhikkhave mahā sakuṇasaṃgho tasmiṃ pallale divasaṃ gocaraṃ caritvā sāyaṃ taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ vāsāya upagacchati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.4.4: atha kho bhikkhave so bhikkhu tassa sakuṇasaṃghassa saddena ubbāḷho yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.4.5: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avocaṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.4.12: tassa kho pana bhante vanasaṇḍassa avidūre mahantaṃ ninnaṃ pallalaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.4.13: atha kho bhante mahā sakuṇasaṃgho tasmiṃ pallale divasaṃ gocaraṃ caritvā sāyaṃ taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ vāsāya upagacchati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.4.16: icchasi pana tvaṃ bhikkhu tassa sakuṇasaṃghassa anāgamanan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.4.17: icchām' ahaṃ bhagavā tassa sakuṇasaṃghassa anāgamanan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.4.18: tena hi tvaṃ bhikkhu tattha gantvā taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ tikkhattuṃ saddam anussāvehi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.4.20: yāvatikā imasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe vāsaṃ upagatā, pattena me attho,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.4.27: atha kho bhikkhave so bhikkhu tattha gantvā taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ tikkhattuṃ saddam anussāvesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.4.37: bhikkhu pattaṃ yācati, bhikkhussa pattena attho 'ti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.4.39: tadā pakkanto 'va ahosi, na puna paccāgañchi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.4.40: tesañ hi nāma bhikkhave tiracchānagatānaṃ pāṇānaṃ amanāpā bhavissati yācanā amanāpā viññatti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.5.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave Raṭṭhapālassa kulaputtassa pitā Raṭṭhapālaṃ kulaputtaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.5.10: so hi nāma bhikkhave Raṭṭhapālo kulaputto sakaṃ pitaraṃ evaṃ vakkhati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.6.1: gihīnaṃ bhikkhave dussaṃharāni bhogāni sambhatāni pi duranurakkhiyāni,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.6.2: tattha nāma tumhe moghapurisā evaṃ dussaṃharesu bhogesu sambhatesu pi duranurakkhiyesu yācanabahulā viññattibahulā viharissatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.6.3: purisaṃ detha purisatthakaraṃ detha goṇaṃ detha sakaṭaṃ detha vāsiṃ detha pharasuṃ detha kuṭhāriṃ detha kuddālaṃ detha nikhādanaṃ detha valliṃ detha veḷuṃ detha muñjaṃ detha babbajaṃ detha tiṇaṃ detha mattikaṃ dethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.6.4: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --la--,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.6.5: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.6.6.1: saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ attuddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā. tatr' idaṃ pamāṇaṃ: dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā tiriyaṃ satt' antarā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.6.7: bhikkhū abhinetabbā vatthudesanāya, tehi bhikkhūhi vatthuṃ desetabbaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:1.6.8: sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane saññācikāya kuṭiṃ kareyya bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya pamāṇaṃ vā atikkāmeyya, saṃghādiseso 'ti. ||6||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.1.2: sayaṃ yācitvā purisaṃ pi purisatthakaraṃ pi goṇaṃ pi sakaṭaṃ pi vāsiṃ pi pharasuṃ pi kuṭhāriṃ pi kuddālaṃ pi nikhādanaṃ pi --pa-- tiṇaṃ pi mattikaṃ pi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.1.4: ullittā vā hoti avalittā vā ullittāvalittā vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.1.8: na añño koci sāmiko hoti itthi vā puriso vā gahaṭṭho vā pabbajito vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.1.12: tatr' idaṃ pamāṇaṃ: dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.2: tena kuṭikārakena bhikkhunā kuṭivatthuṃ sodhetvā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.3: ahaṃ bhante saṃyācikāya kuṭiṃ kattukāmo assāmikaṃ attuddesaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.7: sace sabbo saṃgho ussahati kuṭivatthuṃ oloketuṃ, sabbena saṃghena oloketabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.8: no ce sabbo saṃgho ussahati kuṭivatthuṃ oloketuṃ, ye tattha honti bhikkhū vyattā paṭibalā sārambhaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ aparikkamanaṃ jānituṃ, te yācitvā sammannitabbā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.12: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu saṃyācikāya kuṭiṃ kattukāmo assāmikaṃ attuddesaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.14: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmañ ca itthannāmañ ca bhikkhū sammanneyya itthannāmassa bhikkhuno kuṭivatthuṃ oloketuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.19: saṃgho itthannāmañ ca itthannāmañ ca bhikkhū sammannati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno kuṭivatthuṃ oloketuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.20: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa ca itthannāmassa ca bhikkhūnaṃ sammuti itthannāmassa bhikkhuno kuṭivatthuṃ oloketuṃ so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.22: sammatā saṃghena itthannāmo ca itthannāmo ca bhikkhū itthannāmassa bhikkhuno kuṭivatthuṃ oloketuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.25: tehi sammatehi bhikkhūhi tattha gantvā kuṭivatthuṃ oloketabbaṃ, sārambhaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ aparikkamanaṃ jānitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.26: sace sārambhaṃ hoti aparikkamanaṃ mā yidha karīti vattabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.27: sace anārambhaṃ hoti saparikkamanaṃ saṃghassa ārocetabbaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.29: tena kuṭikārakena bhikkhunā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.30: ahaṃ bhante saṃyācikāya kuṭiṃ kattukāmo assāmikaṃ attuddesaṃ,

pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.2.38: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmassa bhikkhuno kuṭivatthuṃ deseyya.

pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.3.8: na kipillikānaṃ vā āsayo hoti na upacikānaṃ vā āsayo hoti . . . na saṃsaraṇanissitaṃ vā hoti, etaṃ anārambhaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss6:2.3.10: sakkā hoti yathāyuttena . . . nisseṇiyā anuparigantuṃ. etaṃ saparikkamanaṃ nāma. ||3||
